question: ‘Deviants’, a multigenerational queer novel published in February 2025, is authored by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Santanu Bhattacharya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Santanu Bhattacharya** is the author of the highly anticipated second novel titled **'Deviants'**, which was published in **February 2025**.
 
• The book is described as a **multigenerational queer novel** that explores the complexities of **identity**, **family**, and **desire** within the context of changing Indian social norms.
 
• The narrative of **'Deviants'** follows the protagonist, **Shubhro**, and spans several decades, moving from the **1970s** to the present day, primarily set in the city of **Kolkata**.
 
• It delves into the lived experiences of individuals who exist on the margins of society, highlighting the struggle for **self-acceptance** and the **political shifts** that have shaped modern India.
